name: Lavinia Plonka
reason: Her work is mainly physical somatic education (the Feldenkrais Method and her Kinēsa process at the Asheville Movement Center, Asheville, North Carolina), and most of her own catalogue and classes are framed around conditions and body problems (back and neck pain, TMJ, fall prevention, eyesight, balance, chronic pain), so most items fail the health-claim rule; a few emotional and archetype courses and her Shift courses (Embodying Prayer, archetypes, sold on her site through a Shift affiliate link) are the exception. Borderline call: revisit if the owner wants somatic teachers whose spiritual items are a minority.
